about: Dust storm schedule and strength caps (docs/design/f1-storm-spec.md section 2, owner-accepted 2026-11-28). Every number is an invented game-balance number unless its tag says otherwise. Times are simulation sols; a sol is 20 simulation minutes in both pace presets.

warning_lead_sols.tag: learning rule (CR-F3: at least about 1 sol in both presets); never scaled by pace

first_storm.note: Standard 14: balance sheet 2 curve. Classroom 4.5 and 0.5 are chosen, not divided by 4 (owner answer 2026-11-28). Fixed for every world and every player: no rubber-banding.

later_storms.note: Drawn from a generator seeded by (planet seed, storm index); the classroom gap is the standard gap divided by 4.

guards.note: At warning time at least one player must have finished or skipped the Landing and solar supply must be above 0. Otherwise the whole storm moves one sol later, up to 3 times; after that the storm goes ahead and the warning carries the void flag (the forecast resolves void).

caps_note: Strength cap per phase (ARCHITECTURE.md 2.5), keyed on latched gates; the highest latched entry wins. Gates phase_3_begins and equilibrium do not exist yet, so those entries never apply. max_storms is the number of storms scheduled while that entry is the current one (null: no limit); Phase 1 has one storm because the spec says 'Phase 1 has one storm in the slice' (f1-storm-spec.md 2.1). Both are invented.
